# MedReb8

> > MedReb8 specializes in uncaptured pharmaceutical rebates and data aggregation services for hospital pharmacies, helping healthcare organizations maximize revenue through formulary management and manufacturer rebate optimization.

Founded by Bricken and David and operating from Alabama, MedReb8 (Medical Rebates, LLC) provides pharmaceutical data aggregation and rebate capture services specifically for acute care hospitals and 340B-eligible facilities. The platform helps hospitals recover uncaptured drug rebates through utilization data management and manufacturer submissions.

## Key Topics

- Hospital Drug Rebates
- Pharmaceutical Data Aggregation
- Formulary Management
- 340B Program Compliance
- Pharmacy & Therapeutics (P&T) Committees

- Manufacturer Rebate Submissions
